[GENERATED IMPLEMENTATION]
let rec loop (ops: List Int) (coins: Nat) (i: Nat) : Nat :=
  match ops with
  | [] => coins
  | head :: tail =>
    let coins' := if head + coins < 0 then 1 else 0
    loop tail (head + coins) (i + 1) + coins'
loop operations 0 0
[END]
[HELPER LEMMAS]
[END]
[PROOF]
by
  unfold problem_spec
  let result := implementation operations
  use result
  simp [result]
  simp [implementation]
  by_cases h_result: result
  -- Case 1: result is true
  simp [h_result]
  have h_sum_exists := loop.exists_sum_negative operations
  obtain ⟨i, h_i_le, h_sum_neg⟩ := h_sum_exists
  simp [h_i_le, h_sum_neg]
  exact h_result
  -- Case 2: result is false
  simp [h_result]
  have h_no_sum_neg := loop.no_sum_negative operations
  simp [h_no_sum_neg]
  intro h_sum_neg
  simp [h_sum_neg]
  contradiction
[END]
